recipe.visualDefinition: A high-detail 3D render of a white porcelain-like human skull wearing an ornate gold crown, featuring prominent kintsugi-style gold-filled cracks. The skull is set against a matching white marble background with gold-toned veins that align with the cracks in the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: The gold veins in the marble background mimic the kintsugi fractures in the skull.
The ornate, polished gold of the crown contrasts with the matte, bone-white surface of the skull.
The diagonal orientation of the skull creates a sense of weight and rest on the marble surface.
coreInvariants: Kintsugi gold-fill technique in all cracks
Subtle black ink-style tattoos on the skull surface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The skull is centrally located, tilted slightly to the left, occupying approximately 50% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The gold crown serves as the primary visual anchor due to its high detail and metallic sheen.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the gold veins from the background into the kintsugi cracks of the skull, leading upward to the crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the marble background, creating a clean, clinical, yet luxurious atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light grey (marble and bone) providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Gold (crown and kintsugi) providing warmth and focal points.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black (tattoos and deep shadows) providing depth and character.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout with low saturation, except for the metallic gold which has high saturation.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution 3D render of a matte white skull with a gold crown, featuring gold-filled cracks (kintsugi) on a white marble surface with gold veins.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist serif font in a thin weight, placed in the negative space of the marble, using a dark grey or gold foil effect.

verificationChecks: Ensure the gold cracks look like liquid gold poured into fissures.
Check that the marble veins align visually with the skull's fractures.
Verify the crown has intricate filigree and cross motifs.

adjustableVariables: Presence and style of tattoos on the skull
mustRedesign: Avoid generic skull shapes; ensure anatomical accuracy with a porcelain finish.
Ensure the gold is reflective and metallic, not a flat yellow color.

mustAchieve: Photorealistic textures for marble and bone
High-specular highlights on the gold crown
avoid: Oversaturated colors outside of the gold elements

postGenerationChecks: Does the gold look like a separate material from the bone?
Is the lighting consistent across the skull and the marble background?
Are the shadows soft and realistic?
Do the tattoos look like they are etched into the surface?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Human Skull] with [Technique: Kintsugi Gold Repair] and [Accessory: Ornate Gold Crown] set against [Environment: White Marble with Gold Veins] in a [Style: High-Detail 3D Surrealism].
